mapper.sql: id, execution_code, validation_job_id, requester_id, organization_id, class_organization_id, status, version_no, total_rows, processed_rows, succeeded_rows, failed_rows, failure_code, failure_message, credential_file_id, credential_status, credential_expires_at, credential_downloaded_at, queued_at, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_student_import_execution ( id, execution_code, validation_job_id, requester_id, organization_id, class_organization_id, status, version_no, total_rows, processed_rows, succeeded_rows, failed_rows, failure_code, failure_message, credential_file_id, credential_status, credential_expires_at, credential_downloaded_at, queued_at, started_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{execution.id}, #{execution.executionCode}, #{execution.validationJobId}, #{execution.requesterId}, #{execution.organizationId}, #{execution.classOrganizationId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{execution.status}, #{execution.versionNo}, #{execution.totalRows}, #{execution.processedRows}, #{execution.succeededRows}, #{execution.failedRows}, #{execution.failureCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{execution.failureMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{execution.credentialFileId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{execution.credentialStatus}, #{execution.credentialExpiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{execution.credentialDownloadedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{execution.queuedAt}, #{execution.startedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{execution.completedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_student_import_execution WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY queued_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_student_import_execution WHERE requester_id = #{requesterId} AND status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_student_import_execution SET status = 'RUNNING', version_no = version_no + 1, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE sys_student_import_execution SET status = #{status}, processed_rows = #{processedRows}, succeeded_rows = #{succeededRows}, failed_rows = #{failedRows}, credential_file_id = #{credentialFileId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, credential_status = CASE WHEN #{credentialFileId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL THEN 'NONE' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END, credential_expires_at = #{credentialExpiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion} AND #{processedRows} = #{succeededRows} + #{failedRows} AND #{processedRows} <= total_rows AND #{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED')

UPDATE sys_student_import_execution SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE sys_student_import_execution SET status = 'QUEUED', processed_rows = succeeded_rows, failed_rows = 0, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, credential_file_id = NULL, credential_status = 'NONE', credential_expires_at = NULL, credential_downloaded_at = NULL, queued_at = #{queuedAt}, started_at = NULL, completed_at = NULL, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version_no = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('PARTIAL_SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') AND failed_rows > 0 AND credential_status IN ('NONE', 'CONSUMED', 'EXPIRED')

UPDATE sys_student_import_execution SET credential_status = 'CONSUMED', credential_downloaded_at = #{downloadedAt}, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND credential_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion} AND credential_expires_at > #{now}

UPDATE sys_student_import_execution SET credential_status = 'EXPIRED', version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND credential_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion} AND credential_expires_at <= #{now}
